'''Corporate Expansion''' was a division of the [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority]]. During the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], the head of Corporate Expansion was [[Larin Vost]].
